title: Flashed by devlab; the shell flash script retired
done: surya flashed from the pristine stock image by devlab flash and brought back by devlab provision, all 20 checks passing; flash.sh removed, as planned once devlab had done a real flash. A new check, root-fills-its-partition: the first boot had left the system at 2 GB on a 104 GB partition.
rejected: That: two ways to flash drift apart; the shell original stays in git history.

title: The suspend crash found: a FastRPC helper attached at suspend
done: After the flash the audio DSP died on every suspend attempt (the attempts abort at once: the USB link cannot go idle). Found by experiment, one change at a time: not a first-boot effect (9 of 9 on the second boot), not the sensor proxy (15 of 15 without it), but hexagonrpcd's RootPD helper - 0 of 8 without it, and 0 of 9 on a clean boot with it masked, all 21 checks passing. Masked in the manifest, so every flash has it. The check's resume counter, which always said 0, rewritten in awk and checked against a boot with 24.
considered: A hand-made change the manifest lacked; a first-boot effect; the sensor proxy; a stream left open.
rejected: All four, each by its own measurement. The old 'rare' crash was the same one: there the helper died with the first crashes and stayed down.
